"'''Swoop'''" was a member of the [[Dar'manda]], a group of former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] who operated on [[Mek-Sha]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref>{{TORcite|Mek-Sha}}</ref>
